github.name: GitHub
github.description: Searches and works with repositories, issues, and pull requests in your GitHub account.
github.access: Needs a GitHub personal access token, and acts with that token's permissions.
github.dataDestination: Repository, issue, and pull request data is sent to api.githubcopilot.com.

setup.advice: Choose the repositories Zhiyin should work with, or all of them. Under Repository permissions, set Contents, Issues and Pull requests to Read and write: that covers searching, reading and making commits, branches, issues and pull requests. Add Workflows too if it should change GitHub Actions files.
